rows.title: Hermetic calibration actuation
rows.statement: Provide controlled linear calibration motion without a moving shaft penetration through the containment boundary.

rows.title: J2 service access
rows.statement: P003↔P007 shall remain removable so P006/follower service does not require destruction of the containment can.

rows.title: Calibration stroke
rows.statement: Functional rod stroke shall be 10.0 mm.
rows.verification_method: CAD mate/envelope verification + bench stroke measurement

rows.title: Feedthrough envelope
rows.statement: The chamber-side feedthrough interface shall fit within a nominal Ø10 mm input envelope unless a controlled interface change is approved.

rows.title: P007 overall length
rows.statement: P007 overall length shall remain 35.0 mm for the C2R1 mechanical baseline.

rows.title: J2 locating architecture
rows.statement: J2 transverse location shall be controlled by the Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot/locator pair and axial location by the metal mating faces; clamp screws shall not be redundant datum controls.

rows.title: P003 material
rows.statement: P003 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

rows.title: P007 material
rows.statement: P007 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

rows.title: P006 production material
rows.statement: P006 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.
rows.verification_method: Native SOLIDWORKS material readback + reconciled BOM + material certificate at manufacture

rows.title: J2 differential-pressure envelope
rows.statement: J2/P007 qualification differential-pressure envelope shall be -0.20 ... +0.20 bar.
rows.verification_method: Final P007 Static +0.20 bar; Buckling -0.20 bar; leak acceptance test

rows.title: J2 local temperature envelope
rows.statement: For the current release, accepted CFD establishes J2 local temperature at 50-55 degC; use 55 degC as design maximum.
rows.verification_method: Existing CFD is the controlled thermal basis; reopen only after a controlled geometry/flow/thermal-boundary change

rows.title: J2 media/cleaning envelope
rows.statement: Process gas, condensate and cleaning-media species that may contact J2 shall be bounded for elastomer qualification.
rows.verification_method: media specification + supplier compatibility statement + leak qualification

rows.title: J2 static seal
rows.statement: J2 shall use a static face seal architecture sized for the released media, temperature, pressure and service envelope.
rows.verification_method: gland tolerance stack + compression-force qualification + leak test

rows.title: Leak acceptance
rows.statement: A quantitative J2 leak-test acceptance criterion shall be defined before production release.

rows.title: Repeated service life
rows.statement: Required number of J2/P006 service cycles shall be released; provisional 50-cycle screening is not itself a product requirement.

rows.title: Actuator force coefficient
rows.statement: Final electromagnetic design shall meet or exceed the released minimum force/force-coefficient envelope over stroke, current, temperature and production tolerances.

rows.title: Production technical definition
rows.statement: Released manufacturing definition shall unambiguously communicate functionally necessary size, fit, GD&T, material, finish, process and inspection characteristics without contradictory dimensions.
rows.verification_method: drawing semantic QA + visual QA + inspection-plan cross-check
